reuse.why: Extends the existing getCategoriesForBulkBudgetAction selection with one parameter and routes copyPreviousMonth, which had its own hidden check, through it.

duplication.why: The hidden rule now lives once in the shared query; the only repetition is the boilerplate threading of the flag through each action signature, and the pre-existing per-action income check is left as is.

placement.why: The category-eligibility rule stays in the shared selection function in budget/actions.ts, where the tree already decides it.

scope.why: Focused on the flag; routing copyPreviousMonth through the shared selection also makes it apply the template/#fixed exclusions, a small side change in line with the stated rules.

maintainability.why: One explicit parameter on the shared selection is easy to own; the repeated per-wrapper flag plumbing for the N-month averages is verbose but clear.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No bypass; the one action that bypassed the shared selection (copyPreviousMonth) now uses it.

disguised_duplication.where: None introduced; the hidden check in copyPreviousMonth was removed rather than reshaped.
